svg.aria-label: Project 02: Production GitOps Delivery on Amazon EKS Fargate with CloudFront and Keyless CI/CD
svg.title: Project 02: Production GitOps Delivery on Amazon EKS Fargate with CloudFront and Keyless CI/CD
svg.text: Production delivery with no long-lived AWS credentials, and a cluster that
Trust policy restricted to one repository and branch
Static build synced to private S3, served through CloudFront with OAC
ALB as the API origin, HTTPS-only access
Least-privilege Bedrock policy for the backend pod via IRSA
